caption: Sh. 4. Stela (Areika, Pl. 33, No. 5103)
reading: wosi soreyi yiwle teylo(2)wi arokye tedḫelowi si(3)remroke krorolowi sm(4)t krorolowi sobḫe kroro(5)lowi wleke krorolowi a(6)pote qoritowi atmẖe p(7)siḫrkete atomẖepsi(8)ẖekete?[.][.] [.][.]ḫmlol pẖolkete
notes: No word dividers in this copy; spaces are gaps. Copy rows do not match stone lines (line numbers fall mid-row). 'yiwl?e': the two S-shaped signs are near equal in size, e/l order uncertain. 'te' in teylowi: /ϟ with bar, could be o+l. si(3)rem?roke, sm?(4)t?: the 7-shaped sign (ℸ) read m, could be t (no dot visible); the sign under (4) has a dot before it, read t. q?bḫe: /3 could be s+o (sobḫe). m?y?ritowi: ℸ then two strokes (y?), to = ب with dot below. ẖ in mẖe/psiẖe: plain 3, s or ẖ by shape. Line 8 ends in about 3 sign widths of hatching: two strokes just before it read as the // of se (its v lost), then [.][.]. Last row: hatching then a hatched sign (ḫ? by parallel with Sh. 5 and Sh. 7, could be to), [.][.] for the hatching. pso?lkete: /3 could be q (pqlkete). 'p' here is the long-tailed ξ with curled top; 'k' the flat-topped ʒ with long tail.
check_notes: All 28 entries placed. Type settled e/l order in yiwle, m in siremroke/smt, t in smt, wleke (last sign e), sobḫe (/3 = s+o, typist notes q possible), qoritowi (//ℸ = q+o), ẖ in mẖe and pẖolkete (type shows the pointed ẖ). Formula A table stops at 'psiẖeke]'; the prose gives psiẖekete, so the two strokes before the hatching are read as the slash of te (te?), not se.

caption: Sh. 5. Stela (Areika, Pl. 33, No. 5104)
reading: wosi soreyi : qomsḫ(2)rqowi : sqoñye ted(3)ḫeli tedḫelowi msms(4)lẖ?li terikelowi ssi(5)mete mstowi : mlomr(6)se teñtelowi atomẖe p(7)siẖekese atmẖe psi(8)ḫrkese l? ḫmlol pẖolke(9)se
notes: //3 read q+o throughout (the same shape is s+o in soreyi; could also be s+y). m and s (ℸ against 3) unsettled in m?sm?s(4)ls?li and m?sḫwi; the bold 3 in that name looks retouched. ted(3)ḫeli: the last two signs are 4 and a small ϟ (li), not lowi. teñte?lowi: middle /ϟ could be o+l (teñlolowi). Sign after the p in line 7 is hatched (s?). Final l? is a small hatched sign standing alone at the end of the row.
check_notes: All 26 entries placed. Name A printed (qo)msḫrqowi: the first qo is bracketed by Griffith, present in the copy. Name C: the sign under Griffith's ? is an open 3 with long descender in the type (ẖ or m), kept as ẖ?. ḫ in m?sḫwi is the to sign (mstowi). Type 'ssimete : mstowi' has a divider the copy does not show; copy kept. Formula C: the table prints ḫ for the first sign of the second word; the prose prints p and the copy shows a clear p, so p kept. The final l? after psiḫrkese is covered by no entry.

caption: Sh. 6. Stela (Areika, Pl. 34, No. 5105)
labels: sic, over the signs 43 at the end of the name, by line 2
blank, by line 6 (a blank space after the first sign of line 6)
reading: wosi : soreyi : qo : qore(2)qoyeqosi : l?edo : tebde(3)te?moye : terikelowi : nwi(4)[.]ye : tedḫelowi : apote : (5)y?iseboẖe : yetmdelowi : (6)mdos? : t?nbelile : se mlowi : (7)ato : mẖe : psi?ẖekete : a(8)tmẖe : psiḫrkete : ḫml[.](9)l : ẖolkete : mlomrse : (10)teñtelo wi
notes: Griffith draws three holes in the stone (outlined, not hatched): between e and y of soreyi (line 1), before 'ye' after (4) (line 4), and before te after (10) (line 10); I wrote no [.] for them because the outlines may only mark where the text skirts the hole; signs may be lost there. Line 2 'sic' marks 43 (si) where wi is expected. teb?d?e(3)i?m?ye: second and third signs are a hooked v (b or d) and a P-like sign read d as in yetmde; the sign under (3) is hatched, 4-like (i?). (5) stands over the second of two strokes after 4; y?i is uncertain (could be o o i). (6)m?: a lone ℸ, then the blank, then te o and a hatched sign. Line 7 formula: three hatched signs after ps (i?, a 3-shaped one read ẖ?, r?). In line 9 the hatched sign between l and l is likely o (mlol in Sh. 5 and Sh. 7). teñ?te?lo: the crossed sign could be d; second te is hatched at its slash.
check_notes: All 33 entries placed ('medo', title of C in Index A, is placed on the same signs as mdos(?); the copy has a 'blank' space after m, so no e added). qo : before the name is the title qo (Index A/C). The copy's 'si' at the end of the name stays (Griffith's own sic); type has qoreqoyeqowi. Name C tebdetemoye: the hatched sign under (3) is te, and the four strokes are o + y (one sign more than step 1 read). Name B: one [.] added for the hole in the stone, as the names table prints one hatched block (Index C prints two). yiseboẖe: the hatched strokes and the following r-like sign are the se. Formula C at Sh. 6 has no p (type ẖolkete), as the copy. Line 1 'l?edo' (after the name) is covered by no entry.

caption: Sh. 7. Stela (Areika, Pl. 34, No. 5106)
reading: wosi soreyi : tosyeqo(2)wi : tkidye : ted(3)ḫelowi : sbre(4)ye : terikelo(5)wi : atomẖe : psi(6)ẖekete : atmẖe : (7)psiḫrkete : ḫ(8)mlol : pẖolke(9)te si wi : temke(10)ñ : si wi wi l : psi(11)keẖ?kete
notes: b? in the name: a small v with long tail (b or ḫ). k?sidye: first sign 3 with long underline (k or ẖ). psi[.](6)ẖekete: small hatched mark between i and ẖ. Last row: 'si wi' pairs are 43 (si) and 4 with closed loop (wi), read as written; te?kse(10)d?: /ϟ could be o+l, the sign under (10) is a cross with a dot (d, or t), the divider before it has a third dot. psi(11)ẖes?ke?te: two underlined 3-shapes (s? and k), and a hatched sign before te (e?).
check_notes: All 17 entries placed. Name A tosyeqowi: the first sign is to, the small 3 is e. Name B tkidye: re-zoom shows the rightmost hooked sign is t, the flat-topped long-tailed 3 is k (step 1 mis-cut the group). Formula I (siwi : temkeñ : siwiwil : psikeẖ(?)kete) settles the last row; the type has no spaces inside siwiwil, the copy's gaps are kept. The small hatched mark in psi[.](6)ẖekete is dropped: the type has no sign there.
